title: TX queue two-service deadline logic
description: TX queue enforces different deadline models per delivery service. Datagram service: configurable deadline (default 60s), drop when stale. Message service: 120s deadline to reach first custodian; once custody accepted, TX queue deadline no longer applies (absolute TTL governs custody chain). Spec: appendix-bufferbloat.md §2 time-based expiry, 07-transport-app.md §10.2. All three impls.
